POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Metalwork processes in power mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Isometric projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric projection.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Isometric projection.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric projection.

4. When learning Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.

5. When learning Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.

6. When learning Limits, fits and tolerance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Limits, fits and tolerance.

7. When learning ISO Thread forms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ISO Thread forms.
   B. Skip safety briefings for ISO Thread forms.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ISO Thread forms.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ISO Thread forms.

8. When learning Braking system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Braking system.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Braking system.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Braking system.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Braking system.

9. When learning Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Project.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project.

10. When learning Orthographic projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic projection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic projection.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic projection.

11. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

12. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain ISO Thread forms and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Braking system and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Suspension system and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Steering system and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

2. D — Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric projection.

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.

5. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.

6. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Limits, fits and tolerance.

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ISO Thread forms.

8. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Braking system.

9. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project.

10. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic projection.

11. C — CPU
